name: mod-fishing-spots
about: The pirate sits on the trading post's wreck at tier 1 and stands in its rowing boat at tier 3, the building's last (pirate_placed_tN: where FishingModule.as puts him; pirate_reachable_tN: walked up to from the beach, his shop opens; shots pirate-tier-N). Fishing spots in the water: a run spot sits in its potion-refill well's water (spot_in_well, spot_on_the_well, the scene of its well kind), the angler walks up and uses it from the free ground beside it (spot_walk_use), and it grays out (no fish, a faded map icon) once this player's casts are spent (spot_grays_when_fished_out, one cast with fishing.run_casts 1). Shots: coast-2, coast-5 (the town coast spots), run-spot, wells-1/wells-2 (every well kind and the boss bucket, `hwp fishing wells`), run-spot-empty.
